security_boundaries: MCP tool annotations are display hints and never permission authority unless emitted from the project-owned trusted registry.
Every executable tool has a project-owned immutable contract identity, exact least-privilege permission set and side-effect class.
Irreversible writes require host-verified confirmation evidence bound to the exact authorized call identity.
Confirmation evidence is host-local authority and is never accepted from untrusted MCP wire fields or tool arguments.
Unknown tools, unsupported MCP extensions, undeclared arguments and over-granted permissions fail closed.
A validated tool call is an authorization artifact, not proof that any backend action ran or succeeded.
A successful backend result requires exact call binding and non-empty provenance/evidence references before MCP success serialization.
truth_boundaries: This package establishes a project-owned compatibility contract; it does not claim full MCP conformance.
No external MCP server is contacted and no external tool backend is executed by the contract implementation.
No canonical Base weights, tokenizer, dataset, checkpoint, optimizer, training recipe or evaluation payload are changed.
No model training, optimizer update, GPU evidence, paid compute or final-test access is authorized or performed.
Protocol compatibility and security-shape validation do not constitute backend qualification, security certification or production readiness.
